reference_sql:
SELECT channel_id, month, budget_eur,
  LAG(budget_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY month) AS prev_budget_eur
FROM budget_monthly
alternatives:
SELECT b.channel_id, b.month, b.budget_eur,
  (SELECT p.budget_eur FROM budget_monthly p
   WHERE p.channel_id = b.channel_id
     AND p.month = (SELECT MAX(p2.month) FROM budget_monthly p2 WHERE p2.channel_id = b.channel_id AND p2.month < b.month)) AS prev_budget_eur
FROM budget_monthly b

SELECT channel_id, month, budget_eur,
  LAG(budget_eur, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY month) AS prev_budget_eur
FROM budget_monthly

other_way.sql:

other_way.tradeoff: Looking up the budget of the latest earlier month with subqueries works anywhere, but LAG says the same in one line.
